As a longtime fan of the films, Blade Runner 2099 showrunner Silka Luisa says she was more excited than scared when it came to adapting the series for TV. The new show is set 50 years after the 2017 film Blade Runner 2049 and imagines a bleak future where artificial humans known as replicants have taken over society after a brutal war. Luisa, who previously served as showrunner on Apple TV's Shining Girls adaptation, says she largely had to put any concerns about the monumental task of following up Blade Runner out of her mind while working on the show.
